# `door` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "door" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/door/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (debug tools and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, design intent), for owner review. |
| `kind` | `"hinged"` \| `"sliding"` \| `"portcullis"` \| `"trapdoor"` | required | hinged swings about a side, sliding moves sideways into the wall, portcullis rises, trapdoor swings up from the floor. |
| `size` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Leaf width (across the doorway, out from the hinge), height and thickness, metres; a trapdoor: length out from its hinge, length along it, thickness. |
| `seconds` | number > 0 ≤ 60 | required | Seconds to go from fully closed to fully open (and back): its speed. |
| `crush` | number 0–1000000000 | `0` | Blunt hit, J, it delivers to something it closes on; what does not break wedges it (0: it just stops). |
| `manual` | boolean | `true` | Opens and closes by hand (Interact); false for a portcullis that only signals move. |
| `material` | ref → material | required | What the leaf is made of: its world properties. |
| `blocks` | object | required | What it shuts out while closed; open or broken it shuts out nothing. |
| `blocks.light` | boolean | required | Shuts out light when closed. |
| `blocks.gas` | boolean | required | Shuts out gas and smoke when closed. |
| `blocks.sound` | boolean | required | Muffles sound when closed (noise propagation, mw-e09.3). |
| `loudness` | number 0–140 | required | Noise when it starts to move, dB 1 m away (stealth and AI hearing). |
